caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a male figure standing on a trapezoidal, blue-green pedestal with four wheels at its corners. The figure has brown skin and is shown wearing a short skirt made of what appears to be white and blue-grey feathers. He also wears a headband with large, upright feathers in shades of white, blue, and grey. A yellowish-brown belt is tied around his waist. The man is bare-chested, and his right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a small, cylindrical object in his hand. His left hand rests on his hip and grasps a dark object that hangs to his side. The figure is barefoot except for a pair of brown moccasin-like shoes. The background is plain and off-white, highlighting the colors and details of the statue and base.
title: Cigar Store Indian
